description.text:
Now open at 13 Water Street…

Bombay in the 1970s was a city where a modernist aesthetic was starting to take centre stage and there was a fast and glitzy scene in which financiers and industrialists mixed with Bollywood stars. Through its story, design and artwork, this restaurant captures the cosmopolitan nature of this era whilst serving a lovingly curated menu of Bombay comfort food and first-class drinks. Drop by for breakfast, lunch, afternoon chai, dinner or just a tipple or two in this double-height restaurant, bar and terrace, overlooking the water.

Soft launch 15 – 29 November, fully open from Wednesday 30 November.
